    SELECT 
        ROUND(CAST(safetyindex * ((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0) * (1.0 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0) * 0.8 AS numeric), 2) as ospi
    FROM equipment
) sub;

        ROUND(CAST(safetyindex * ((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0) * (1.0 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0) * 0.8 AS numeric), 2) as ospi

) sub;
